title: Understanding the Plot
text: The plot shows a U-shaped curve. This suggests that as the value of $$d$$ increases, the y-axis value decreases to a minimum point and then increases again. This is typical of a bias-variance tradeoff.

title: Possible Y-Axis Labels
text: Consider what the y-axis could represent in the context of machine learning models. Common metrics include training error, validation error, test error, bias, and variance.

title: Validation Error
text: The U-shaped curve is characteristic of validation error in relation to model complexity. As complexity increases, validation error typically decreases to a point and then increases due to overfitting.
